examples.text: На первый взгляд всё выглядит логично: учитель владеет фактическим материалом, а дети его не знают. Значит, не учат. А раз так — нужно наказывать их отметками, терроризировать родителей.

glosses: To fill (someone) with terror; to terrify.

examples.text: The gang continued to terrorize the neighborhood.
She felt terrorized by the constant threats.

glosses: To coerce (someone) by using threats or violence.
Non-Oxford British English standard spelling of terrorize.

examples.text: Though unusual in the Dublin area he knew that it was not by any means unknown for desperadoes who had next to nothing to live on to be abroad waylaying and generally terrorising peaceable pedestrians by placing a pistol at their head…
